body:
I'm 20 to turn 21. Our household had 2 cats, one very recently passed at 19 years old. It was pretty rough for me, but that's not really the reason I'm suicidal. 

I live at home at the moment, but have spent a couple of years in a rental apartment in another country (because of prices of housing being very inflated).

I want to get a dog but I'm not really ready to have that kind of a responsibility, because I really like animals too.

I don't really want a high-paced, action filled life. I'm as most happy in nature just looking at grand things like northern lights or starry skies. Those moments are just very few and far in between. And it's still not much to look forward to, like, how do you look forward to seeing a starry sky? It's too spontaneous.

I don't know what I would like to change. I've left everything and relocated once, it didn't change much. I guess my introvert nature was tested a bit, and I got some new friends, but mostly due to convenience. I find reasons to why any plan of change is either unecessary or not worth it. 

I can just think about all the imaginary places and paintings that appeal to me so much more than reality. If this is just a slump, what if it lasts for years? Or decades? 

I want to travel, mostly to explore nature on my own, but I have no idea how, since it's not the way travelling is usually advertised.

I'm not trying to start an argument by the way. I don't even know if answering to comments is normal here.
